aliases: How do I start a demo password reset?
intents.approved_answer: Open the demo sign-in page and select Forgot password.

required_excerpts.text: Open the demo sign-in page and select Forgot password.

aliases: How do I complete a demo password reset?
intents.approved_answer: Use the reset link sent to your demo email address to choose a new password.

required_excerpts.text: Use the reset link sent to your demo email address to choose a new password.

aliases: What should I do if my demo reset link expires?
intents.approved_answer: If your reset link has expired, request a new link from the demo sign-in page.

required_excerpts.text: If your reset link has expired, request a new link from the demo sign-in page.

aliases: How do I connect to the demo campus Wi-Fi?
intents.approved_answer: Select the Acme-Campus demo Wi-Fi network and sign in with your demo account.

required_excerpts.text: Select the Acme-Campus demo Wi-Fi network and sign in with your demo account.

aliases: How do visitors connect to the demo Wi-Fi?
intents.approved_answer: Visitors use the Acme-Guest demo Wi-Fi network and the guest code supplied by their host.

required_excerpts.text: Visitors use the Acme-Guest demo Wi-Fi network and the guest code supplied by their host.

aliases: What should I try if the demo Wi-Fi connection fails?
intents.approved_answer: If the demo Wi-Fi connection fails, forget the network and reconnect.

required_excerpts.text: If the demo Wi-Fi connection fails, forget the network and reconnect.

aliases: What do I need before setting up the demo VPN?
intents.approved_answer: You need an active demo account.

aliases: How do I set up the Campus VPN profile?
intents.approved_answer: Install the Acme VPN client, sign in, and select the Campus profile.
